summary_md: **Prompt Engineer 48 ([@prompt48](https://x.com/prompt48/status/2116609616918552619))** tested **GEAR** (rsi-gear), an MIT framework where a meta agent reads failed traces and proposes harness changes that are promoted only if they score better; the README reports Terminal-Bench 2.1 rising from 52.8% to 62.9% without retraining, though he notes these are self-measured, some tasks were used in optimization and stronger models gained little ([rsi-gear/gear](https://github.com/rsi-gear/gear), [quick start](https://rsigear.xyz/docs/gear/quickstart), [video](https://youtu.be/_z5DFSgPIts)).
